run_download_tokenizer_cli: run the download_tokenizer script to download a llama2 tokenizer to a specified directory
run_download_tokenizer_hf: run the download_tokenizer script with an api_key to download a llama3 tokenizer from Hugging Face
run_download_tokenizer_tiktoken: run the download_tokenizer script to download a tiktoken encoding to a cache directory
run_download_tokenizer_gemma: run the download_tokenizer script to download the gemma tokenizer model to a local path
run_download_tokenizer_check_error: run the download_tokenizer script with an invalid tokenizer name to see the error message
